sentences.text: 3. This Court upon a perusal of the case file prima facie finds that the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioners are either triable by a court of Magistrate and/or do not contain the maximum punishment of more than seven years, and keeping in mind the provisions contained in Section 41, 41-A Cr.P.C. as well as the judgment passed by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar, reported in AIR 2014 SC 2756, the dictum of which squarely apply mutatis mutandis to the present case, it is directed that in case, the arrest of the petitioners is found to be absolutely necessary by the Investigating Agencies, instead of affecting the arrest of the petitioners at once, a prior notice of one month shall be given to them so that they may exercise their rights.
